name: UAC
source: CRON 2026-10-07: group consolidated statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 2025, printed page 26 of _ngx_pdf/UACN.pdf (PDF page 28), and the group five-year financial summary, printed page 96 (PDF page 98). The group statement shows a Minimum tax line of (810,641) separate from the income tax expense of (5,705,903), so the Income Tax row for FY2025 is the total 6,516,544, which is also the 6,517 the five-year summary prints for 2025 and is what makes profit before taxation less income tax equal the profit for the year. FY2023 to FY2022 come from the FY2023 audited annual report (uacnplc.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/UACN-ANNUAL-REPORT-2023.pdf) because the FY2025 summary repeats the FY2024 taxation figure in its FY2023 column, which cannot be reconciled to that summary own profit after tax of 8,908. FY2021 is from the group five-year summary, with profit before taxation derived from the printed profit after tax and taxation. EPS is the group basic earnings per share in naira (printed kobo / 100): 362 and 497 kobo. Unit: naira (printed NGN thousand x 1,000). | FILL 20261007_145458: UAC of Nigeria Plc FY 2023 results presentation and earnings release (group highlights table, N million) | FILL 20261007: H1 2026 cells written from UAC of Nigeria Plc unaudited condensed interim financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib, consolidated statement of profit or loss), Group six months ended 30 June 2026 column, printed in N'000 and stored as absolute naira. CORRECTION: the H1 2026 column held figures this statement does not print (cost of sales 260,420,145 against a printed 260,411,795; gross profit 104,550,000 against 104,558,350; operating expenses 55,590,000 against 57,273,671; operating profit 48,960,000 against 48,965,817; profit before tax 34,450,000 against 34,445,459; income tax 14,424,097 against 14,419,556). The printed values replace them. Operating expenses is the sum of the printed selling and distribution expenses 34,078,443, administrative expenses 23,053,040 and impairment loss on financial assets 142,188. Ties exactly: revenue 364,970,145 less cost of sales 260,411,795 equals gross profit 104,558,350; gross profit plus dividend income 100,117 plus other operating income 1,581,021 less 57,273,671 equals operating profit 48,965,817; 48,965,817 less net finance cost 15,853,929 plus share of profit from associates 1,333,571 equals profit before tax 34,445,459; 34,445,459 less income tax 14,419,556 equals profit for the period 20,025,903.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.derivedFrom: minimum tax plus income tax expense of continuing operations
rows.derivedFormula: Income Tax = Profit Before Tax - Net Profit

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.derivedCellFormula: Debt to Equity = Total Liabilities / Total Equity

derivation.ratiosNote: ratio cells tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures of this security, not printed in the source

source_note: H1 2026 column rebuilt 2026-10-06 from UAC of Nigeria Plc unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026 as reported (proshare.co and thebusinesstimesng.com, filed with NGX on 29 July 2026): Revenue N364.97bn; gross profit N104.55bn; operating profit N48.96bn (EBIT margin 13.4%); Profit before tax N34.45bn; profit after tax N20.03bn; basic EPS 658 kobo. UNIT: NGN. Cost of Sales and Income Tax are DERIVED (Revenue minus Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Net Profit) so the column ties to the published figures; Revenue and Net Profit are the exact figures already in the file. Net finance costs were described only as just under N16bn and Operating Expenses only as an approximate ratio, so both are left empty rather than approximated. Prior H1 2026 cell set was wrong: Cost of Sales had been back-filled as Revenue minus Net Profit and Gross Profit, Operating Profit and Profit Before Tax had all been set to the Net Profit figure. Identities checked: Revenue minus Cost of Sales = Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax = Net Profit.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024, FY2021: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed.
periodOrder: repaired 2026-10-04: periods were not newest-first; reordered so periods[0] is the newest period and every value stays on its own period label
